## Summary

Searched `C:\Users\UserX\Downloads\mcp-server-solidworks-main` (medium depth). Bottom line: **three of the things you asked about do NOT exist in this repo** — no `FullyDefineSketch`, no `sgFIXED`, no MMGS/unit API, no PNG/screenshot export. What exists is the *plumbing* for constraints, SaveAs, and export in a narrow set of formats. All SolidWorks COM work is **C#**, not Python; Python only does MCP transport + IR compilation.

## 1. Fully defining sketches — NOT PRESENT

- No `IFeatureManager.FullyDefineSketch`, no `sgFIXED`, no DOF/under-defined reporting anywhere (grepped `.cs`, `.py`, `.json`, `.md`). `AutoDimension` appears only as `AutoDimensionDrawing` (`SolidWorksService.Drawing.cs:1957`), which dimensions a **drawing**, not a sketch.
- Nearest usable primitive: `modelDoc.SketchAddConstraints(swConstraintId)` at `C:\Users\UserX\Downloads\mcp-server-solidworks-main\execution\solidworks\SolidworksExecution\Services\SolidWorksService.Sketch.cs:834`, driven by the `add_sketch_constraint` tool (`SolidWorksService.Sketch.cs:757`).

Exact constraint-id map in use (`SolidWorksService.Sketch.cs:800-814`):

```csharp
"horizontal"    -> "sgHORIZONTAL"
"vertical"      -> "sgVERTICAL"
"coincident"    -> "sgCOINCIDENT"      // two entities
"parallel"      -> "sgPARALLEL"        // two entities
"perpendicular" -> "sgPERPENDICULAR"   // two entities
"tangent"       -> "sgTANGENT"         // two entities
"equal"         -> "sgSAMELENGTH"      // two entities
"midpoint"      -> "sgATMIDDLE"        // two entities
```

Selection pattern (the load-bearing part — point-based, not index-based), `SolidWorksService.Sketch.cs:820-834`:
